recipe: git fetch --depth 1 https://github.com/asizikov-demos/copilot-user-level-statistics-viewer c2b2324d8b5179280bb1a3b2634200885d68cfbc && git checkout --force c2b2324d8b5179280bb1a3b2634200885d68cfbc
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund   # upstream package-lock.json, in a throwaway work directory
apply the integration patches listed below (exact-anchor string replacements)
esbuild: React entry (Providers + app/page) -> minified IIFE, next/link shimmed, Next.js runtime not used
inline CSS, app JS, worker source, plugin-version JSON and gzip+base64 sample report into index.html

integrationChanges.reason: Single-file build has no GitHub Pages base path.
Opaque-origin iframe cannot load a same-origin worker script; start the pre-bundled worker from an inline Blob URL.
Declare the build-time worker source constant.
Use the pinned plugin-version JSON embedded at build time instead of fetch().
Load the sample report from a gzip+base64 block embedded in the HTML instead of fetch().
getBasePath is no longer used here.
Mirror the in-memory view state in location.hash (#/view, #/userDetails/<id>/<login>) so every page is hash-addressable and Back/Forward work.

window.print() is blocked without allow-modals: keep Print visibly disabled and add a standalone HTML download (summary DOM, inline styles, charts as data: images, no scripts) with a data-handling warning.
Import the vendored executive summary export helper.
Next.js static export replaced by a direct esbuild bundle of the same client components; next/link aliased to a plain <a>.
Added: standalone executive summary HTML export (Blob download).
Inline error overlay surfaces uncaught errors, unhandled rejections, CSP violations and invalid hash routes visibly.
External (non-#) link clicks are cancelled with a visible notice because the sandbox grants no popups or top navigation.
Build fails if the bundle needs eval/new Function ('unsafe-eval' is never granted).
Workdir must be outside this repository and new/empty or marked with .vendor-copilot-usage-viewer-owner.json for this commit before any forced checkout/clean.

Content-Security-Policy meta: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; font-src data:; worker-src blob:; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'

runtime.networkAccess: none (connect-src none; no fetch, no external scripts, styles, fonts or images)
runtime.navigation: hash routes #/<view> and #/userDetails/<id>/<login>; unknown or malformed routes show the error banner and fall back
disabledFeatures: Print / Save PDF (window.print needs allow-modals; replaced by standalone HTML download)
external links (need allow-popups / top navigation; cancelled with a visible notice)

executiveSummaryExport.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
executiveSummaryExport.contents: rendered Executive Summary DOM, inline CSS, charts as PNG data: URLs; no scripts, no source records
